hidden.name: Start the check
hidden.title: Sends the selected protest ID to the server.
hidden.why: The server only accepts a protest already present in its public bundle.
hidden.here: If clicked, the browser sends the selected ID to /api/racing/protest and opens an event stream for progress and the result.

code.plain: The button starts the check, and the text says the server replays the saved protest.
This click handler starts the check for the selected protest.
The browser sends a POST with the protest ID.
It opens an event stream and waits for the result or an error.

hidden.name: Queue the replay
hidden.title: Checks the ID and starts the protest replay process.
hidden.why: The browser sends an ID, not a file path to run on the server.
hidden.here: The server refuses an unknown ID; for a known protest it queues replay_one with that ID.

code.plain: The route validates the protest and queues the replay command.

hidden.name: Find the saved lines
hidden.title: Finds one stored protest line in each of two arms.
hidden.why: Both saved versions have to reproduce for the page to show a full match.
hidden.here: The replay process looks up the selected protest in each saved arm file and refuses if a line is missing or duplicated.

code.plain: The loop finds the protest in each arm and starts replaying each saved line.

hidden.name: Copy the saved inputs
hidden.title: Copies each record bundle, frame files, and saved model replies.
hidden.why: Replay needs the same inputs that the stored ruling record names.
hidden.here: For each arm, the worker copies the record bundle, the referenced frame images, and ledger replies into a temporary folder.

code.plain: This part copies the saved ruling line and its bundle.
These lines copy frame files and stored replies named by the bundle.

hidden.name: Rebuild the stored ruling
hidden.title: Replays each line from its bundle and compares the bytes.
hidden.why: This checks that the saved record still matches its saved inputs and ruling.
hidden.here: Faultline checks the bundle hash and that the line matches its saved ruling; replay_one then compares rebuilt output bytes with the original.

code.plain: This calls the offline replay and compares the rebuilt bytes with the stored line.
The replay reads the saved bundle and checks its hash.
It also checks the saved ruling matches the line before writing the rebuilt output.
The record hash is a SHA-256 of canonical JSON.

hidden.name: Return the check result
hidden.title: Compares both arms and returns a match or mismatch.
hidden.why: The browser needs a plain result for the protest it checked.
hidden.here: The worker reports match true only when both arms rebuild; code says the page then marks the pack same or different. This result screen was not observed.

code.plain: The worker reports whether every saved arm matched.
The page changes the case status and displays the returned result.

hidden.unsure: No request was sent, so the live match or mismatch screen was not observed.

silent.title: This is a record check, not a new ruling
silent.text: The live button rebuilds the saved records from their stored bundles and replies. It does not ask a steward or a model to make a new contact decision.
